_doc: Per-file line-coverage baselines (whole percent points) PLUS the excluded_files allowlist for source files that produce NO LCOV records (static-only modules, feature-gated tiers CI doesn't enable). Both lists are consulted by scripts/coverage_ratchet.py; every source file in crates/*/src/**/*.rs must appear in exactly one. See docs/COVERAGE.md.

excluded_files.crates/rubund/src/lib.rs: single-line `pub mod parser;` — no executable code
all `#[used] static` declarations — no executable lines for LCOV to instrument; closes the gap flagged on PR #274
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/http_server.rs: behind the `_http_server` Cargo feature; the default CI coverage run uses default features
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/json_native.rs: behind the `_json_native` Cargo feature (serde_json accelerator for the pure JSON canon, ADR 0019 Rule 6); default CI build excludes
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/kramdown_native.rs: behind the `_kramdown_native` Cargo feature (rostdown kramdown accelerator); default CI build excludes (same shape as rouge_native below)
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/liquid_native.rs: behind the `_liquid_native` Cargo feature (liquidus template accelerator); default CI build excludes (same shape as rouge_native below)
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/rouge_ir.rs: behind the `_rouge_native` Cargo feature (Track C AST→IR compiler); default CI build excludes (same shape as rouge_native below)
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/rouge_native.rs: behind the `_rouge_native` Cargo feature (carmine rouge accelerator); default CI build excludes (same shape as json_native above)
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/yaml_native.rs: behind the `_yaml_native` Cargo feature (native translation of the blessed YAML loader); default CI build excludes (same shape as rouge_native above)
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/sqlite.rs: behind the `_sqlite` Cargo feature (rusqlite + bundled libsqlite3 + SQLite3::Database/Statement surface, ADR 0027); default CI build excludes (same shape as http_server / stdlib / fiber / json_native above)
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/vm/cext_wasi.rs: cfg(target_os = "wasi") gated; only compiled on wasm32-wasip1, not on the Linux coverage runner
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/vm/fiber.rs: behind the `_fiber` Cargo feature; the default CI coverage run uses default features (matches the http_server / stdlib pattern above)
excluded_files.crates/rubyrs/src/encoding_full.rs: feature-gated (_encoding_full) — not built on the default CI coverage run; unit tests live in-module and run under the feature
